purpose: Isolate the incremental position residual-GRU effect while retaining the parent cosine-attitude-GRU, frozen C5 position controller, and the fixed W09 dual-notch action filter.

fixed_controls.attitude_controller: same parent cosine-GRU controller and model as the bound same-scene baseline
fixed_controls.position_controller: same frozen C5 position model/options as the bound same-scene baseline
fixed_controls.position_residual_gru_runtime: disabled; no residual_gru runtime field is passed

applied_position_action_filter.location: after final C5 action and before force injection

invariants.exact_options_check: After removing only the dual-notch runtime payload, the runner must assert equality with the frozen C5 baseline options; residual GRU is absent, not removed from the comparison.
invariants.model_reference_only: The former residual-GRU model, fold and checkpoint stay hash-bound for lineage only; this ablation must not deserialize or evaluate those weights.
invariants.disabled_model_parity: Position residual-GRU forward parity is intentionally not run because that model is absent from the runtime.
invariants.notch_helper_parity: R2025b recurrence and coefficient parity must pass for both frozen TRAIN W09 action sequences.
invariants.no_plant_boundary: Stop before the first main-loop transition; zero attempt and first-Plant markers.
invariants.forbidden_scope: No TEST/VAL reads, no inertia reconstruction, no Plant calls.

interpretation_limit: No closed-loop effect or position-Q cost is measured by this no-Plant ablation. Any future comparison requires a separately authorized one-call run per scene and must preserve the original frozen replay FAIL.
